dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular elliptical and C-shaped structures are visible along the mid-flank. These exhibit a sharp gradient transition from dark charcoal interiors to high-intensity cream perimeters. The edges are scalloped and vary in thickness, with the most prominent O-ring located posteriorly showing a thick, continuous high-contrast boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity asymmetrical clusters throughout the dorsal and lateral regions. Core pixel concentration is highest in the centers of the ringed structures and becomes more compact and irregular near the cranial region, lacking the light-intensity internal gradient found in the mid-body flank regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest posterior macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body. A secondary linear arrangement of four smaller high-intensity blobs is visible posterior to the pectoral flipper attachment.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct white lattice-like pattern connects the macro-annuli, creating a high-contrast net-like appearance across the lateral surface.
